# Tools

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:tools` from the server's tools/list. Do not edit by hand. -->

superflow-mcp registers 21 tools. With `SUPERFLOW_READ_ONLY=true` only the 10 read-only tools are registered.

Every id parameter also takes a name, URL, email or number: the API resolves it. Comment numbers need a project, or `SUPERFLOW_DEFAULT_PROJECT`.

## superflow_get_me

**Who am I**

Show who this Superflow API key belongs to: the member, the workspace, its plan, and the key's scopes.
Use it when the user asks which account is connected, or after a forbidden error to check the scopes.
It does not list teammates. For that use superflow_list_members.

No parameters.

Example:

```json
{}
```

## superflow_list_projects

**List projects**

List the Superflow projects (websites) this key can see, with site URL, install status and open comment count.
Use it to find a project's exact name or id, or to answer questions like which sites have the most open comments.
For the pages inside one project use superflow_list_pages. For comment counts by any other dimension use superflow_comment_stats.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | no | Filter by project name or site URL (substring, case-insensitive). |
| `include_archived` | boolean | no | Include archived projects. Default false. |
| `limit` | integer | no | How many rows to return, 1 to 100. Default 25. |
| `cursor` | string | no | Opaque cursor from a previous call's next_cursor. Use it with the same filters to get the next page. |

Example:

```json
{"query":"acme"}
```

## superflow_list_pages

**List pages**

List the pages of one project with their open and total comment counts.
Use it to see which pages have feedback, to find pages with zero comments, or to get exact page URLs before filtering comments.
For the comments themselves use superflow_list_comments. For counts per page under other filters use superflow_comment_stats with group_by page.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | yes | Project: its name ("Acme Dental"), site URL or domain ("acme.com"), or id (prj_...). |
| `query` | string | no | Filter by page URL or title (substring). |
| `with_counts` | boolean | no | Include comment counts per page. Default true. |
| `limit` | integer | no | How many rows to return, 1 to 100. Default 25. |
| `cursor` | string | no | Opaque cursor from a previous call's next_cursor. Use it with the same filters to get the next page. |

Example:

```json
{"project":"Acme Dental","with_counts":true}
```

## superflow_list_members

**List members and guests**

List workspace members (your team) and, when a project is given, that project's guests (clients and reviewers).
Use it to find the exact name or email to use for assignee, author or an @mention, or to see who has access to a project.
Not for the key's own identity: use superflow_get_me.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | no | Project (name, site URL or id). When given, the project's guests are included after the members. |
| `query` | string | no | Filter by name or email (substring). |

Example:

```json
{"project":"Acme Dental","query":"jen"}
```

## superflow_list_statuses

**List statuses**

List the comment statuses (workflow columns) in order, with which ones count as resolved.
Use it before filtering or updating by status, to get the exact status names. Give a project to include its custom statuses.
To count comments per status use superflow_comment_stats with group_by status.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | no | Project (name, site URL or id). Omit for the workspace defaults. |

Example:

```json
{"project":"Acme Dental"}
```

## superflow_list_tags

**List tags**

List comment tags with how often each is used. Give a project to include its project tags.
Use it to find exact tag names before filtering, tagging or bulk updating by tag.
To count comments per tag under other filters use superflow_comment_stats with group_by tag.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | no | Project (name, site URL or id). Omit for workspace-wide tags. |

Example:

```json
{"project":"Acme Dental"}
```

## superflow_list_comments

**List comments**

List comments in Superflow with filters. Use this to find, review or read specific comments: by project, page, status, assignee, author, tags, dates, text, device, source or agent run.
For totals or breakdowns (how many per page, per status, per assignee) use superflow_comment_stats instead, it is cheaper. For a file of many rows use superflow_export_comments.
Returns compact rows by default; set fields "full" only when you need every field. Pages with cursor.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | string or array of string | no | Project or projects: name, site URL, domain or id. Omit for every project the key can see. |
| `page_url` | string | no | Page URL to match. See page_match. |
| `page_match` | `exact`, `prefix`, `contains` | no | How page_url matches: exact (default; ignores the query string unless you give one), prefix, or contains. |
| `status` | array of string | no | Status names or ids, or the words "open" (every unresolved status) and "resolved". |
| `priority` | array of `none`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `critical` | no | Priorities to include. |
| `assignee` | array of string | no | Assignees: names, emails, ids, "me", or "unassigned" for comments with no assignee. |
| `author` | array of string | no | Authors: names, emails or ids (usr_..., gst_...), or "me". |
| `author_type` | array of `member`, `guest`, `agent` | no | member (your team), guest (clients and reviewers) or agent (AI review agents). |
| `tags` | array of string | no | Tag names or ids. See tags_match. |
| `tags_match` | `any`, `all` | no | any (default): a comment with any of the tags. all: every tag. |
| `query` | string | no | Case-insensitive text search over every message in the thread. |
| `created_after` | string | no | Created at or after. ISO date (2026-10-01) or a token: 24h, 7d, 2w, 1m, today, yesterday, this_week, last_week. |
| `created_before` | string | no | Created before. ISO date (2026-10-01) or a token: 24h, 7d, 2w, 1m, today, yesterday, this_week, last_week. |
| `updated_after` | string | no | Last activity at or after. ISO date (2026-10-01) or a token: 24h, 7d, 2w, 1m, today, yesterday, this_week, last_week. |
| `updated_before` | string | no | Last activity before. ISO date (2026-10-01) or a token: 24h, 7d, 2w, 1m, today, yesterday, this_week, last_week. |
| `resolved_after` | string | no | Approximate: resolved threads whose last update is at or after this. ISO date (2026-10-01) or a token: 24h, 7d, 2w, 1m, today, yesterday, this_week, last_week. |
| `resolved_before` | string | no | Approximate: resolved threads whose last update is before this. ISO date (2026-10-01) or a token: 24h, 7d, 2w, 1m, today, yesterday, this_week, last_week. |
| `has_attachments` | boolean | no | true: only threads with attachments. false: only threads without. |
| `has_replies` | boolean | no | true: only threads with replies. false: only threads with none. |
| `has_external_link` | boolean | no | Linked to an external tracker. Matches nothing yet (Phase 1). |
| `unanswered` | boolean | no | true: the last message is from a guest or agent and no team member replied after it. |
| `stale_days` | integer | no | Not resolved and no activity for at least this many days. |
| `device` | array of `desktop`, `mobile`, `tablet` | no | Device the comment was made on. |
| `source` | array of `widget`, `extension`, `figma`, `voice`, `api`, `agent` | no | Where the comment came from: widget (toolbar), agent, api, figma, voice, extension. |
| `agent` | string | no | AI review agent name or id (agt_...). |
| `agent_run` | string | no | Agent run id (run_... or the raw execution id). |
| `sort` | `updated_desc`, `created_desc`, `created_asc`, `priority_desc`, `page`, `number` | no | Sort order. Default updated_desc (most recent activity first). |
| `limit` | integer | no | How many rows to return, 1 to 100. Default 25. |
| `cursor` | string | no | Opaque cursor from a previous call's next_cursor. Use it with the same filters to get the next page. |
| `fields` | `compact`, `full` | no | compact (default): short rows. full: every field, use only when you need anchors, metadata or authors in detail. |

Example:

```json
{"project":"Acme Dental","status":["open"],"page_url":"acme.com/pricing","page_match":"prefix"}
```

## superflow_get_comment

**Get a comment**

Get one comment with every field: page, status, priority, assignee, author, tags, pin position, attachments, and its replies.
Use it when the user names a comment ("comment 4821", "#4821", or a cmt_ id) or after a list call to read a thread in full.
A comment number needs a project unless SUPERFLOW_DEFAULT_PROJECT is set. To search or list many comments use superflow_list_comments.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `comment` | string | yes | Comment: its number ("4821" or "#4821") or id (cmt_...). Numbers need a project. |
| `project` | string | no | Project for a comment number (name, site URL or id). Not needed for cmt_ ids. Defaults to SUPERFLOW_DEFAULT_PROJECT when set. |
| `include_replies` | boolean | no | Include the thread's replies. Default true. |

Example:

```json
{"comment":"4821","project":"Acme Dental"}
```

## superflow_comment_stats

**Comment stats**

Count comments grouped by one dimension (status, priority, assignee, author, author_type, page, tag, project, source, device, day or week), with the same filters as superflow_list_comments.
Use it for "how many", "per page", "per assignee", "trend by week" and response-time questions (metrics avg_hours_to_resolve, median_hours_to_first_reply). It is much cheaper than listing.
To read the comments behind a number use superflow_list_comments with the same filters.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | string or array of string | no | Project or projects: name, site URL, domain or id. Omit for every project the key can see. |
| `page_url` | string | no | Page URL to match. See page_match. |
| `page_match` | `exact`, `prefix`, `contains` | no | How page_url matches: exact (default; ignores the query string unless you give one), prefix, or contains. |
| `status` | array of string | no | Status names or ids, or the words "open" (every unresolved status) and "resolved". |
| `priority` | array of `none`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `critical` | no | Priorities to include. |
| `assignee` | array of string | no | Assignees: names, emails, ids, "me", or "unassigned" for comments with no assignee. |
| `author` | array of string | no | Authors: names, emails or ids (usr_..., gst_...), or "me". |
| `author_type` | array of `member`, `guest`, `agent` | no | member (your team), guest (clients and reviewers) or agent (AI review agents). |
| `tags` | array of string | no | Tag names or ids. See tags_match. |
| `tags_match` | `any`, `all` | no | any (default): a comment with any of the tags. all: every tag. |
| `query` | string | no | Case-insensitive text search over every message in the thread. |
| `created_after` | string | no | Created at or after. ISO date (2026-10-01) or a token: 24h, 7d, 2w, 1m, today, yesterday, this_week, last_week. |
| `created_before` | string | no | Created before. ISO date (2026-10-01) or a token: 24h, 7d, 2w, 1m, today, yesterday, this_week, last_week. |
| `updated_after` | string | no | Last activity at or after. ISO date (2026-10-01) or a token: 24h, 7d, 2w, 1m, today, yesterday, this_week, last_week. |
| `updated_before` | string | no | Last activity before. ISO date (2026-10-01) or a token: 24h, 7d, 2w, 1m, today, yesterday, this_week, last_week. |
| `resolved_after` | string | no | Approximate: resolved threads whose last update is at or after this. ISO date (2026-10-01) or a token: 24h, 7d, 2w, 1m, today, yesterday, this_week, last_week. |
| `resolved_before` | string | no | Approximate: resolved threads whose last update is before this. ISO date (2026-10-01) or a token: 24h, 7d, 2w, 1m, today, yesterday, this_week, last_week. |
| `has_attachments` | boolean | no | true: only threads with attachments. false: only threads without. |
| `has_replies` | boolean | no | true: only threads with replies. false: only threads with none. |
| `has_external_link` | boolean | no | Linked to an external tracker. Matches nothing yet (Phase 1). |
| `unanswered` | boolean | no | true: the last message is from a guest or agent and no team member replied after it. |
| `stale_days` | integer | no | Not resolved and no activity for at least this many days. |
| `device` | array of `desktop`, `mobile`, `tablet` | no | Device the comment was made on. |
| `source` | array of `widget`, `extension`, `figma`, `voice`, `api`, `agent` | no | Where the comment came from: widget (toolbar), agent, api, figma, voice, extension. |
| `agent` | string | no | AI review agent name or id (agt_...). |
| `agent_run` | string | no | Agent run id (run_... or the raw execution id). |
| `group_by` | `status`, `priority`, `assignee`, `author`, `author_type`, `page`, `tag`, `project`, `source`, `device`, `day`, `week` | yes | The dimension to group by. |
| `metrics` | array of `count`, `avg_hours_to_resolve`, `median_hours_to_first_reply` | no | Metrics per group. Default ["count"]. Hours metrics may be approximate. |

Example:

```json
{"project":"Acme Dental","status":["open"],"group_by":"page"}
```

Export the comments that match the filters as csv, json or markdown, for a report, a spreadsheet or a client update.
Under 500 rows the file comes back inline in content; larger exports return a download_url that works for 1 hour.
To read or count comments in the conversation use superflow_list_comments or superflow_comment_stats instead.

## superflow_create_comment

**Create a comment**

Create a new comment on a page of a project, as the key's member. Optionally pin it to an element, and set priority, status, assignee, tags and attachments.
The comment is public, the same as a comment left with the Superflow toolbar in normal (not private) mode: everyone with access to the project can see it.
Superflow has three priorities: critical (P0), high (P1) and medium (P2). Use "none" or leave priority out for no priority.
Use it when the user asks to leave or log feedback on a page. To answer an existing thread use superflow_add_reply instead.
Ask the user before creating comments they did not ask for.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | yes | Project: its name ("Acme Dental"), site URL or domain ("acme.com"), or id (prj_...). |
| `page_url` | string | yes | Full URL of the page the comment is about. |
| `text` | string | yes | The comment text. @Name or @email mentions notify those people. |
| `anchor` | object (selector, xpath, x, y, element_text, viewport, device) | no | Where on the page the comment is pinned. Omit for a page-level comment. |
| `priority` | `critical`, `high`, `medium`, `none` | no | Superflow has three priorities: critical (P0), high (P1) and medium (P2). "none", or leaving it out, creates the comment without a priority. |
| `status` | string | no | Status name or id. "open" means the default status and "resolved" the resolved status. |
| `assignees` | array of string | no | The assignee: one name, email or id, or "me". A comment has one assignee. Leave it out for no assignee. |
| `tags` | array of string | no | Tags to add. Unknown tag names are created in the comment's project. |
| `attachments` | array of object (url, name) | no | Files to attach, by public URL. |
| `on_behalf_of` | string | no | Post as this existing project guest (email). Needs the users:invite scope. |
| `idempotency_key` | string | no | Optional key so a retried call is not applied twice. Same key within 24 hours returns the first result. |

Example:

```json
{"project":"Acme Dental","page_url":"https://acme.com/pricing","text":"The CTA button overlaps the nav on mobile.","priority":"high","tags":["mobile"]}
```

## superflow_update_comment

**Update a comment**

Change one comment: text, priority, status, assignee, tags (replace, add or remove), page URL or pin position.
Superflow has three priorities: critical (P0), high (P1) and medium (P2). Clearing the priority or removing the assignee is not supported yet: set a different value, or tell the user to change it in the Superflow toolbar.
Use it for a single comment. To resolve or reopen prefer superflow_resolve_comment and superflow_reopen_comment (they can post a note). For many comments use superflow_bulk_update_comments.
Ask the user before changing comments they did not ask about.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `comment` | string | yes | Comment: its number ("4821" or "#4821") or id (cmt_...). Numbers need a project. |
| `project` | string | no | Project for a comment number (name, site URL or id). Not needed for cmt_ ids. Defaults to SUPERFLOW_DEFAULT_PROJECT when set. |
| `text` | string | no | New text for the comment's first message. |
| `priority` | `critical`, `high`, `medium` | no | Superflow has three priorities: critical (P0), high (P1) and medium (P2). Clearing a priority is not supported yet. |
| `status` | string | no | Status name or id. "open" means the default status and "resolved" the resolved status. |
| `assignees` | array of string | no | The new assignee: one name, email or id, or "me". It replaces the current assignee, since a comment has one. Removing the assignee is not supported yet: tell the user to unassign in the Superflow toolbar. |
| `add_assignees` | array of string | no | Same as assignees: one name, email or id, or "me". It replaces the current assignee, since a comment has one. Removing the assignee is not supported yet: tell the user to unassign in the Superflow toolbar. |
| `tags` | array of string | no | Replace all tags with these. [] removes every tag. Unknown tag names are created in the comment's project. |
| `add_tags` | array of string | no | Tags to add. Unknown tag names are created in the comment's project. |
| `remove_tags` | array of string | no | Tags to remove. |
| `page_url` | string | no | Move the comment to this page URL. |
| `anchor` | object (selector, xpath, x, y, element_text, viewport, device) | no | Where on the page the comment is pinned. Omit for a page-level comment. |

Example:

```json
{"comment":"4821","project":"Acme Dental","priority":"high","assignees":["Jen"],"add_tags":["mobile"]}
```

## superflow_resolve_comment

**Resolve a comment**

Mark one comment resolved, optionally posting a note as a reply first (for example what was fixed).
Safe to repeat: if it is already resolved nothing changes and the note is not posted.
To resolve many comments at once use superflow_bulk_update_comments with patch {"resolve": true}. To undo use superflow_reopen_comment.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `comment` | string | yes | Comment: its number ("4821" or "#4821") or id (cmt_...). Numbers need a project. |
| `project` | string | no | Project for a comment number (name, site URL or id). Not needed for cmt_ ids. Defaults to SUPERFLOW_DEFAULT_PROJECT when set. |
| `note` | string | no | Reply to post before resolving. |

Example:

```json
{"comment":"4821","project":"Acme Dental","note":"Fixed in the latest deploy, please check."}
```

## superflow_reopen_comment

**Reopen a comment**

Reopen one resolved comment (back to the default status), optionally posting a note as a reply first.
Safe to repeat: if it is already open nothing changes and the note is not posted.
To reopen many comments use superflow_bulk_update_comments with patch {"reopen": true}.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `comment` | string | yes | Comment: its number ("4821" or "#4821") or id (cmt_...). Numbers need a project. |
| `project` | string | no | Project for a comment number (name, site URL or id). Not needed for cmt_ ids. Defaults to SUPERFLOW_DEFAULT_PROJECT when set. |
| `note` | string | no | Reply to post before reopening. |

Example:

```json
{"comment":"4821","project":"Acme Dental","note":"Still broken on Safari."}
```

## superflow_add_reply

**Reply to a comment**

Post a reply in a comment thread, as the key's member. @Name, @First Last or @email in the text mention and notify people on the project.
Use it to answer a comment or nudge someone. To close the thread with a note use superflow_resolve_comment with note instead.
Ask the user before posting replies they did not ask for.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `comment` | string | yes | Comment: its number ("4821" or "#4821") or id (cmt_...). Numbers need a project. |
| `project` | string | no | Project for a comment number (name, site URL or id). Not needed for cmt_ ids. Defaults to SUPERFLOW_DEFAULT_PROJECT when set. |
| `text` | string | yes | Reply text. Mentions: @Name, @First Last or @email. |
| `attachments` | array of object (url, name) | no | Files to attach, by public URL. |
| `idempotency_key` | string | no | Optional key so a retried call is not applied twice. Same key within 24 hours returns the first result. |

Example:

```json
{"comment":"4821","project":"Acme Dental","text":"Fixed, please check. @Jen can you confirm on mobile?"}
```

## superflow_update_reply

**Edit a reply**

Edit the text of one reply. Only the reply's author or a workspace owner or admin can edit it.
Reply ids look like rpl_<comment>.<reply> and come from superflow_get_comment. To change a comment's first message use superflow_update_comment with text.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `reply` | string | yes | Reply id (rpl_...), from superflow_get_comment. |
| `text` | string | yes | New reply text. |

Example:

```json
{"reply":"rpl_8f3k2.654321","text":"Fixed in v2.3, please check again."}
```

## superflow_delete_reply

**Delete a reply**

Delete one reply. Only the reply's author or a workspace owner or admin can delete it, and it cannot be restored.
Without confirm: true nothing is deleted: you get the reply back as a preview to show the user. Call again with confirm: true only after the user says yes.
To delete a whole thread use superflow_delete_comment.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `reply` | string | yes | Reply id (rpl_...), from superflow_get_comment. |
| `confirm` | boolean | no | Must be true to delete. Set it only after the user explicitly agreed in this conversation. Default: `false`. |

Example:

```json
{"reply":"rpl_8f3k2.654321"}
```

## superflow_delete_comment

**Delete a comment**

Delete one comment thread with its replies. It can be restored with superflow_restore_comment until restore_until.
Without confirm: true nothing is deleted: you get the comment back as a preview to show the user. Call again with confirm: true only after the user says yes.
To close a comment without deleting it use superflow_resolve_comment. There is no bulk delete: delete one comment at a time.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `comment` | string | yes | Comment: its number ("4821" or "#4821") or id (cmt_...). Numbers need a project. |
| `project` | string | no | Project for a comment number (name, site URL or id). Not needed for cmt_ ids. Defaults to SUPERFLOW_DEFAULT_PROJECT when set. |
| `confirm` | boolean | no | Must be true to delete. Set it only after the user explicitly agreed in this conversation. Default: `false`. |

Example:

```json
{"comment":"4821","project":"Acme Dental"}
```

## superflow_restore_comment

**Restore a comment**

Restore a deleted comment thread, with its replies, before its restore window ends.
Use it when the user wants a deleted comment back. It does not reopen resolved comments: use superflow_reopen_comment for that.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `comment` | string | yes | Comment: its number ("4821" or "#4821") or id (cmt_...). Numbers need a project. |
| `project` | string | no | Project for a comment number (name, site URL or id). Not needed for cmt_ ids. Defaults to SUPERFLOW_DEFAULT_PROJECT when set. |

Example:

```json
{"comment":"cmt_8f3k2"}
```

## superflow_bulk_update_comments

**Bulk update comments**

Change many comments at once (up to 200): set status, priority or assignee, add or remove tags, or resolve or reopen with an optional note.
Superflow has three priorities: critical (P0), high (P1) and medium (P2). Clearing the priority or removing the assignee is not supported yet.
Select comments either by comment_ids or by a filter (the same filters as superflow_list_comments). A filter that matches more comments than the API can scan is refused: narrow it, for example by project or date.
It is a dry run by default: you get how many comments would change, how many already match, and a sample. Nothing is written. Show that to the user. Only after they say yes, call again with dry_run: false and confirm: true.
For one comment use superflow_update_comment or superflow_resolve_comment.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `comment_ids` | array of string | no | Comments to change: numbers ("4821") or ids (cmt_...). Give this or filter, not both. |
| `project` | string | no | Project for comment numbers in comment_ids (defaults to SUPERFLOW_DEFAULT_PROJECT when set). With filter, it is used as the filter's project when the filter has none. |
| `filter` | object (project, page_url, page_match, status, priority, assignee, author, author_type, tags, tags_match, query, created_after, created_before, updated_after, updated_before, resolved_after, resolved_before, has_attachments, has_replies, has_external_link, unanswered, stale_days, device, source, agent, agent_run) | no | Select comments with the same filters as superflow_list_comments. Give this or comment_ids, not both. |
| `patch` | object (status, priority, assignees, add_assignees, add_tags, remove_tags, resolve, reopen, note) | yes | The change to apply to every selected comment. At least one field. |
| `dry_run` | boolean | no | Default true: preview only. false writes, and also needs confirm: true. |
| `confirm` | boolean | no | Must be true (with dry_run false) to write. Set it only after the user explicitly agreed. Default: `false`. |
| `idempotency_key` | string | no | Optional key so a retried call is not applied twice. Same key within 24 hours returns the first result. |

Example:

```json
{"filter":{"project":"Acme Dental","tags":["copy"],"page_url":"acme.com/","status":["open"]},"patch":{"resolve":true,"note":"Copy updated."}}
```

## superflow_add_attachment

**Add an attachment**

Attach a file to a comment (its first message) or to a reply, by public URL. Superflow downloads the file from the URL.
Give exactly one of comment or reply. Use it when the user shares a screenshot or file link that belongs on a thread.
To post text use superflow_add_reply (it can carry attachments too).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `comment` | string | no | Comment: its number ("4821" or "#4821") or id (cmt_...). Numbers need a project. |
| `reply` | string | no | Reply id (rpl_...). Give this or comment, not both. |
| `project` | string | no | Project for a comment number (name, site URL or id). Not needed for cmt_ ids. Defaults to SUPERFLOW_DEFAULT_PROJECT when set. |
| `url` | string | yes | Public https URL of an image, video or PDF, at most 25 MB. |
| `name` | string | no | File name to show. Defaults to the URL's file name. |

Example:

```json
{"comment":"4821","project":"Acme Dental","url":"https://files.example.com/fix.png","name":"fix.png"}
```

# Prompts

| Prompt | Arguments | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `triage` | `project`, `since` (optional) | Group a project's open comments by page and propose a priority and assignee for each, then apply after you agree. |
| `stale_threads` | `project`, `days` (optional) | Find threads waiting on your team for N days and draft one nudge per assignee. |
| `client_update` | `project`, `since` (optional) | Draft a short client update: what closed, what is open, and what we need from the client. |
| `agent_findings_review` | `agent_run` | Review the findings of one AI agent run, flag likely false positives, and propose which to resolve as noise. |
| `find_duplicates` | `project`, `page_url` (optional) | Find near-duplicate open comments in a project and propose merges. |
| `launch_checklist` | `project` | Pre-launch check: open comments by priority, and pages nobody has reviewed yet. |

# Resources

| URI | Description |
|---|---|
| `superflow://projects` | The projects this key can see (first page), same JSON as superflow_list_projects. |
| `superflow://projects/{project}` | One project with its first page of pages, as { project, pages }. |
| `superflow://projects/{project}/comments{?status,page_url,assignee}` | Comments in a project, same JSON as superflow_list_comments. Optional query: status, page_url, assignee (comma separated lists). |
| `superflow://comments/{comment}` | One comment with replies, same JSON as superflow_get_comment. Numbers use SUPERFLOW_DEFAULT_PROJECT. |
